svg.aria-label: Your first flow, from an empty canvas to a note: right-click the canvas and choose Use this canvas to create notes, give it the role, press Create the first step and pick a note step, which starts the flow on its own; Edit step, Add an action, Ask for text, write the question; then the ribbon's Create note opens the wizard, which asks it and creates the note.
